authority: CEO Round 125 deep audit directive: 'Do not call that "world-class invention" in the permanent epistemic state. Create this internal promotion state: WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR. Then WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION only after the reality gate is satisfied.'
status: SPECIFICATION. The two-tier state is defined; it is NOT yet wired into the portfolio controller.

governance_compliance.article_I: A promotion state is granted only after the evidence supporting it exists.
governance_compliance.article_IV: No fallback — failure of reality gate does NOT promote a virtual survivor to invention.
governance_compliance.article_V: Fail closed — a candidate that fails reality gate remains a virtual survivor (or is killed), never auto-promoted.
governance_compliance.article_VII: A failed reality gate is corrected by improving the experiment or narrowing the claim — never by weakening the promotion state.
governance_compliance.article_IX: The promotion state machine is observational — promoting a candidate does not modify the candidate's evidence.
governance_compliance.article_X: Canonical state has one authority — promotion_state is recorded in CANONICAL_STATE/PORTFOLIO.json and propagated to the portfolio scoreboard; nowhere else.
governance_compliance.article_XIV: RED = STOP — a red gate blocks promotion regardless of other green gates.
governance_compliance.article_XV: Disclosure of any state transition, with the evidence supporting it.
governance_compliance.article_XVII: Adversarial test: what would make a virtual survivor look like a real invention?
governance_compliance.article_XXVI: Locally verified ≠ CI-certified. A virtual survivor promoted by a local run is NOT a CI-certified virtual survivor.
governance_compliance.article_XXVII: Promotion thresholds (which gates must be green) are explicit, not drift-adjustable.
governance_compliance.article_XXVIII: Virtual survivor is NOT a confirmed invention — passing the virtual campaign does NOT grant credit at the reality gate.
governance_compliance.article_XXIX: A reality-gate failure is a PHYSICAL_CONTRADIICTION, not an implementation failure — separated from simulator misconfiguration.
governance_compliance.article_XXXII: Strongest alternative explanation for a virtual survivor: the virtual worlds share a hidden assumption (circular validation). Test via cross-world adversarial variation.
governance_compliance.article_XXXIII: No irreversible promotion on unresolved evidence.
governance_compliance.article_XXXIV: Reality gate is the explicit trigger for moving from virtual survivor to invention.
governance_compliance.article_XXXV: The two-tier state preserves the closed-loop epistemic control system: virtual survivor = loop produced its own next falsification experiment; invention = loop includes physical reality.

FDA_computational_modeling_framework.position: FDA explicitly treats computational Modeling & Simulation (CM&S) as evidence that can complement traditional testing, including virtual cohorts.
FDA_computational_modeling_framework.caveat: FDA emphasizes that credibility depends on verification, validation, context of use, and available evidence. Credibility is NOT a universal binary property.
FDA_computational_modeling_framework.implication_for_promotion_state: A virtual survivor has FDA-recognized credibility WITHIN ITS CONTEXT OF USE. It does NOT have the credibility of a validated physical device. The two-tier state reflects this distinction.
FDA_computational_modeling_framework.source: FDA Risk-Informed Credibility Assessment framework for computational modeling (referenced in EPISTEMIC_CONSTITUTION.md Article XXXV).

ASME_VV_40.position: ASME V&V 40 frames credibility as risk- and context-dependent, not as a universal binary property.
ASME_VV_40.implication_for_promotion_state: The 'world-class' label cannot be universally applied. It must be earned relative to the context (virtual survivor in computational context; invention in physical/clinical context).
ASME_VV_40.source: ASME V&V 40-2018, Verification & Validation in Computational Modeling of Medical Devices (referenced in Article XXXV).

regulatory_grounding.synthesis: Both frameworks distinguish computational credibility from physical/clinical validation. The two-tier state encodes this distinction explicitly in the epistemic record.

STATE_1_DISCOVERY.label: DISCOVERY
STATE_1_DISCOVERY.definition: Candidate has been identified and entered into the portfolio. No gates have been passed yet.
STATE_1_DISCOVERY.permission: Run the AI loop against this candidate.
STATE_1_DISCOVERY.next_state_on_success: VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR_CANDIDATE (intermediate, when ≥1 gate is green but not all required gates).
STATE_1_DISCOVERY.next_state_on_failure: KILLED (with documented reason and cemetery entry).

STATE_2_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR_CANDIDATE.label: VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR_CANDIDATE
STATE_2_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR_CANDIDATE.definition: Candidate is progressing through the virtual campaign. Some required gates are green; not all are green yet.
STATE_2_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR_CANDIDATE.permission: Continue the AI loop. Acquire next experiment per the V3 acquisition function.
STATE_2_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR_CANDIDATE.next_state_on_success: WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR (when ALL required virtual gates are green).
STATE_2_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR_CANDIDATE.next_state_on_failure: KILLED (with documented reason and cemetery entry).
STATE_2_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR_CANDIDATE.honest_caveat: This is an intermediate state. It must NOT be reported as 'survivor' or 'validated' externally. Only WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR is reportable.

STATE_3_WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR.label: WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR
STATE_3_WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR.definition: The candidate survived the complete adversarial computational campaign across all applicable independent physics worlds. Earned promotion out of the discovery queue.
STATE_3_WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR.permission: Freeze virtual dossier. Move to next candidate. Begin reality-gate preparation (physical experiment protocol).
STATE_3_WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR.next_state_on_failure: REALITY_KILLED (reality gate contradicted virtual prediction; cemetery entry with epistemic_class=STRONG_CONSTRAINT).
STATE_3_WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR.required_gates: All 17 gates in PROMOTION_GATE_SPEC_V1.json green (or justified NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_WORLD).
what_this_state_does_NOT_mean: Does NOT mean the candidate is a validated invention.
Does NOT mean the candidate is clinically useful.
Does NOT mean the candidate will survive physical experiment.
Does NOT mean FDA will accept the computational evidence as sufficient.
Does NOT mean the candidate can be marketed, sold, or implanted.
what_this_state_DOES_mean: The candidate survived every applicable virtual world.
The candidate's load-bearing assumptions have been tested across independent simulators.
The candidate's competing hypotheses have been discriminated.
The candidate's parameter space has been adversarially swept.
The candidate's claim-evidence graph is GREEN for all virtual-supported claims.
The candidate is the highest-priority candidate for physical experiment resource allocation.
STATE_3_WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR.article_XXVIII_note: Per Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion), WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR is NOT a partial invention. It is a different epistemic class — computational credibility, not physical validation.

STATE_4_WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION.label: WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION
STATE_4_WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION.definition: The candidate survived both the virtual campaign AND the reality gate. Physical experiment confirmed the virtual prediction. The candidate is a closed-loop validated system per Article XXXV.
STATE_4_WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION.permission: Move to buyer/regulatory dossier preparation. Slot is 'filled' in the portfolio.
STATE_4_WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION.required_gates: All 17 virtual gates green + reality_gate green + closed_loop_operational green (Article XXXV).
reality_gate_requirements: Physical experiment executed per frozen protocol (e.g., PEP-SLOT5-001-a2 for Slot 5).
Physical experiment result confirms virtual prediction within pre-registered tolerance.
Physical experiment was pre-registered BEFORE execution (no post-hoc threshold adjustment).
Physical experiment data ingested into model; model updated; updated model still predicts the phenomenon.
No new failure modes introduced by physical experiment that were not anticipated virtually.
what_this_state_means: The candidate is a world-class invention per the constitution.
The candidate has earned its slot in the portfolio permanently.
The candidate can move to regulatory submission (subject to FDA/CE requirements).
STATE_4_WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION.article_XXXV_note: Per Article XXXV, the invention is complete ONLY when the closed loop is operational: discovery → hostile attack → simulator → VVUQ → virtual cohort → experiment → automatic ingestion → model update → next experiment → dossier. WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION requires this loop, not just a single physical experiment.

STATE_5_KILLED.label: KILLED
STATE_5_KILLED.definition: The candidate failed a virtual gate and was killed. Recorded in the mechanism cemetery with the kill reason and reusable lesson.
STATE_5_KILLED.permission: Cemetery entry created. Slot may be reopened for a replacement candidate (Slot 5 pattern) OR closed permanently if the kill reason is PROVEN_INVARIANT.
epistemic_class_options: PROVEN_INVARIANT — hard block, cannot be reopened
STRONG_CONSTRAINT — reopenable only with new evidence that overturns the constraint
MODEL_SPECIFIC — reopenable in a different model form
FAILURE_LESSON — reopenable if the failure mode is addressed
UNRESOLVED_WARNING — yellow-gate kill, reopenable if the unresolved evidence resolves

STATE_6_REALITY_KILLED.label: REALITY_KILLED
STATE_6_REALITY_KILLED.definition: The candidate was a WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR but the reality gate contradicted the virtual prediction. A particularly informative kill — the virtual campaign was wrong.
STATE_6_REALITY_KILLED.permission: Cemetery entry with epistemic_class=STRONG_CONSTRAINT. Trigger a virtual-campaign audit: what hidden assumption did all virtual worlds share that reality exposed?
STATE_6_REALITY_KILLED.article_XXIX_note: This is a PHYSICAL_CONTRADIICTION, not an implementation failure. The virtual worlds were not misconfigured — they were wrong about reality. This is the most informative outcome possible.
STATE_6_REALITY_KILLED.lesson_value: Extremely high. A reality kill teaches the virtual campaign what to test differently next time.

machine_enforcement_rules.rule_1_no_skipping_reality_gate: The engine MUST refuse to transition from WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR to WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION without a green reality_gate entry backed by physical experiment data.
machine_enforcement_rules.rule_2_no_aggregate_promotion: Multiple virtual worlds agreeing does NOT promote to invention. Reality gate is a separate, mandatory gate.
machine_enforcement_rules.rule_3_no_silent_state_change: Every state transition is recorded with: previous state, new state, triggering gate, evidence hash, commit hash, timestamp.
machine_enforcement_rules.rule_4_no_reality_gate_self_certificatio: The agent that ran the virtual campaign CANNOT be the same agent that certifies the reality gate. Independent review required.
machine_enforcement_rules.rule_5_no_partial_reality_gate: Reality gate is BINARY: the physical experiment either confirms the virtual prediction within pre-registered tolerance OR it does not. No partial credit.
machine_enforcement_rules.rule_6_reality_gate_pre_registration_req: The physical experiment protocol (e.g., PEP-SLOT5-001-a2) must be frozen BEFORE execution. No post-hoc threshold adjustment.
machine_enforcement_rules.rule_7_closed_loop_required_for_inventio: Per Article XXXV, WORLD_CLASS_INVENTION requires the closed loop to be operational: physical data ingested, model updated, updated model still predicts the phenomenon.

anti_gaming_safeguards.safeguard_1_no_label_inflation: WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR may NOT be externally reported as 'world-class invention' or 'validated invention'. External reporting must use the full label including 'VIRTUAL'.
anti_gaming_safeguards.safeguard_2_no_circular_promotion: A candidate cannot promote itself by re-interpreting its own virtual evidence. New evidence (physical) is required for reality-gate promotion.
anti_gaming_safeguards.safeguard_3_no_quota_pressure: Five slots is a CEILING, not a quota. Zero world-class inventions is an acceptable outcome. Five simultaneous virtual survivors is suspicious, not celebratory (per audit pushing-the-envelope principle).
anti_gaming_safeguards.safeguard_4_no_reality_gate_shortcut: The reality gate cannot be skipped because 'the virtual evidence is overwhelming'. Per Article XXVIII, virtual evidence does NOT confirm physical reality.
anti_gaming_safeguards.safeguard_5_no_state_drift: Once WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR is granted, the candidate's virtual dossier is FROZEN. Subsequent virtual changes do not affect the survivor state — only the reality gate can promote further.
anti_gaming_safeguards.safeguard_6_no_cemetery_circumvention: A killed candidate cannot re-enter the portfolio as a 'new' candidate without explicit reopen justification per Article XXIX.
